lines.en: I walk through the ferns.
My staff bumps the roots.

lines.zh: 我走路一点声音都没有
lines.en: I make no sound at all when I walk.
These woodland trails are mine.
I listen to birds as I walk.
Leaves cling to my mask.
I skirt a ring of mushrooms.
I head toward the light.
My bone charms clink.
I am in no hurry whatsoever.
A herbal smell follows me.

lines.zh: 我在这片林子里住了很久
lines.en: I have lived in this wood a long while.
I steady myself on a trunk.
I walk your way.
I stand in the wood.
I listen to wind in the leaves.
My mask is old.
I wait for a bird to land.
I shake a small bell softly.
Tree shadows move across me.
I study the mycelium on the ground.
The wood is just quiet enough.
I crouch and rise again slowly.
I do not disturb anyone.
My staff rests on my shoulder.
I am counting tree rings.
A leaf landed on my head.
I can smell the season turning.
I gaze deeper into the wood.
The woodland grass speaks between us.
I look at you through the leaves.
Your steps are too hurried.
You carry a blade.
The drum in the woods is mine.
Would you like to sit and rest?

lines.zh: 这棵树的影子正好落在你身上
lines.en: The tree's shadow lands right on you.

lines.zh: 我认得你踩坏的那片苔
lines.en: I know the moss you trampled.
You are looking for a way, are you not?
I can point you the way.

lines.zh: 你看着我的面具做什么
lines.en: Why do you stare at my mask?
I do not harm travelers.
One bone charm fell.
I yield a little ground.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的念词
lines.en: That broke my murmuring.
I did not cry out once.
I press below my ribs.
My staff knocked against a tree.
I can treat this.
You have stirred the wood.
I will keep a remedy for you.
I do not blame you for it.
Is that a herb you brought?
I will take it; I lacked this.

lines.zh: 林子里能吃的东西不多
lines.en: There is little to eat in this wood.
Keep it; I am not short.
I will dry it and store it.
This can go with my remedies.
Steady; I do not want it spilled.
Set it on that stone first.
This smells like spring.
Thank you; I owe you a favor.
I do not eat what strangers bring.
You look hungrier than I am.
I will split this half with you.
You carry a great deal with you.
On the ground is fine.
Take your time; no hurry.
You bumped my staff.
I gave a little ground.
Do not rush; the wood is wide.
My bone charms are fragile.
You stepped on my herb pouch.
Just make a little room, both of you.
That was a very light bump.
Let us go around each other.
This way; that way has thorns.
I gave my life to this wood.
I set such things aside long ago.
The one behind the mask is not suited.
That question troubles me.
These trees are my companions.
Let us change the subject.
I do not plan to leave here.
You should find your own kind.
I shook my head without a word.
It is late; go back.
I lift it with my staff.
This fell on the ferns.
Let me see whose it is.
I tuck it into my herb pouch for you.
There is some mud on it.
Yours; here.
I can take it without bending.
I have seen this once before.
Careful with dropping things.
Put it away properly.
The leaves told me you came.
You have taken the wrong path.
I did not raise my staff to strike.
I raise my staff to guide, not to strike.
Follow along behind me.
There are snares around here.
You have wandered this wood a long while.
Come closer and I must intervene.
I have remembered your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上没有记号，很危险
lines.en: Unmarked as you are, you are in danger.
I watch you from behind a tree.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枝条我听得到
lines.en: I hear every branch you break.
I have followed you a while.
You have circled three times.
This is a mushroom ring; stay out.
I will wait ahead.
I am faster than you in this wood.

lines.zh: 我的杖一直指着一个方向
lines.en: My staff keeps pointing one way.
That path leads to the marsh.
I must act.
My staff hits your shoulder.
This staff is only to bar your way.
My wooden staff comes down with a dull thud.
Step back and I will not follow.
I struck very lightly.
You covered your head; sensible.
It is the wood helping me.
After this, please leave.
I do not wish to raise my staff again.
I was already in this wood.
The leaves moved before I appeared.
Did you hear the leaves rustle?
This is my home.
I walk slowly onto the trail.
The wood went quiet for a moment.
I brought the smell of herbs.
I did not mean to startle you.
Fire is the worst thing in a wood.
I landed on a root.
Water soaked my powders.

lines.zh: 爆炸惊飞了整片林子的鸟
lines.en: The blast scattered every bird.
An arrow stuck in my mask.

lines.zh: 咒语在我身上打了个转
lines.en: The spell turned back on me.
There is too little to eat here.
Lightning split the tree above.
There is not a single tree here.
